newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK sends 1,997 pigeons to China in handover symbol.
newsitem.headline: HK sends 1,997 pigeons to China in handover symbol.

text.p: Pigeon fanciers released 1,997 homing pigeons on a flight to China on Tuesday in a feathery celebration of Hong Kong's return to Beijing in 21 days.
The pigeons, dispatched by the Hong Kong Sports Institute and sports authorities of neighbouring Guangdong province, headed back to the provincial capital Guangzhou.
A spokesman said: "They were brought from the province as a symbol of Hong Kong's return to the embrace of motherland China."
The first pigeon arrived home later, taking about three and a half hours for a 270-km (162-mile) journey at the southern tip of China.
In pre-handover festivities, "1997" is shorthand for the transition of Hong Kong, a British colony for 156 years, back to China on July 1 as a special region with autonomy.
